title: Supernova Event Dataset: Interpreting Large Language Models’ Personality through Critical Event Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting target LLMs to sample and rank the five most critical events from diverse long-form texts (e.g., biographies, historical events, scientific discoveries, and movie scripts), then using an external LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate these selections to reveal the models' underlying subjective values, personality traits, and narrative preferences.
